note: RELEASE KEYS. Each entry is a public key this build accepts registry packages from. The key that signs the shipped bundled package (registry/bundled.lrp) is pinned here: created 2026-11-16 with tools/registry-pack keygen; its private half is kept outside the repository. The second entry is an offline backup key, created 2026-11-21 the same way and also active, so that a lost release key does not end catalog updates. Rotation: add the new key as active and sign with it, then set the old key to revoked. Test keys never go in this file (see the debug source set).
